people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’ ”
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
translations.kjv: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
translations.asv: Jesus said unto him, Again it is written, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.
